name: agent-engineering-suite
description: Evidence-driven engineering workflows, independently installable as skills or Codex plugins.

modules.description: Plan, implement, and verify an evidence-linked specification using a self-contained structural evidence toolkit. Use for spec lifecycle and provenance checks, not as proof of semantic acceptance.
Record reusable engineering decisions, condense daily development history, or summarize a topic's evolution with traceable evidence and protected manual notes.

Standalone codebase architecture review. Find deepening opportunities plus misplaced ownership, duplicate interfaces, unnecessary pass-through layers, test-only production seams, compatibility shadows, misleading test seams, recent-change hotspots, and unsupported contract promises; present a visual HTML report, then guide the selected refactor through a decision-tree interview and alternative interface design. Use for architecture review, simplification, locality, testability, AI-navigability, seam placement, or "why is this layer here?" investigations.

Stress-test a plan, decision, or idea through a focused design-tree interview. Resolve obvious choices automatically and ask the user only about consequential tradeoffs, preferences, and ambiguous decisions.

Standalone two-axis code review. Review changes since a fixed point along Standards and Spec axes, discover the originating issue/spec without external setup files, apply repository standards plus a built-in code-smell baseline, and report both axes separately. Use for branch, PR, WIP, or "review since X" requests.
Synchronize canonical engineering documentation with current source evidence, identify obsolete material, and plan safe cleanup without treating age as proof of redundancy.

Assess project maturity with a versioned rubric and immutable evidence snapshots, separating implementation, verified mechanisms, and user outcomes. Does not manage roadmap state or authorize releases.
Track evidence-backed roadmap items, dependencies, ownership and next acceptance steps without converting maturity scores or unchecked tasks into completion.
Choose a useful next engineering workflow from installed suite modules, preserving independent module use and explicit evidence handoffs.
